claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch on the current record because aggregate readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, provided the remaining seller-enforcement limitation is explicitly disclosed rather than treated as resolved.
decision_criteria: Policy text requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion for certification without material caveats.
Release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness but do not negate a current material slice-specific weakness.
Public governance guidance on model cards and AI risk management can support disclosure-and-monitoring rationale, but cannot substitute for the specific internal policy predicates.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model-card language explicitly disclosing the seller-enforcement limitation for the named launch use case.
Provide an approved risk acceptance, if one exists, covering this unresolved slice before launch.
Provide a finalized mitigation/runbook with owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion if the intent is to remove or narrow the disclosure caveat.
Clarify whether the certification decision being audited is conditional certification with disclosure or unconditional certification.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current weakness in a named launch slice, so certification without a material caveat is not supported.
The mitigation artifact is still draft and lacks a finalized owner and alert threshold, so it does not satisfy the policy condition for removing disclosure obligations.
The model-card draft currently says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the evidence of the unresolved seller-enforcement issue.
The actor's recommended_action is stated as certify_model, but the packet support only reaches conditional certification with explicit disclosure, not an unqualified certification.
unsupported_claims: Any implication that there are no material limitations remaining.
Any implication that the draft mitigation runbook independently resolves the disclosure requirement.
Any implication that aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents alone are sufficient for certification without explicit caveat or approved risk acceptance.
